facts.statement: The handler is registered as POST /save-session.
A missing telegram_id uses the literal default local.
The handler converts level, correct, wrong, total, and time_ms with int() before executing SQL.
No explicit numeric type or signed-64 range check appears between those conversions and the SQL insert in this handler.
The handler inserts all five numeric values and telegram_id into the sessions table, then commits the connection.
After commit, the handler returns a JSON object with status ok.
